era: The 2018-2020 Healthline redesign every visitor saw in 2019: white header with teal hamburger, teal SUBSCRIBE and the black healthline wordmark centered, condensed bold Proxima Nova headlines, small teal uppercase category labels, LATEST STORIES / MORE TOP READS lists, Spotlight programs and a footer with About Us, Contact Us, Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Advertising Policy, Careers, Health Topics, Find an Online Doctor, Newsletters and the Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Pinterest and Flipboard icons. Captures 2019-03 to 2019-12 agree.
